about_page.title: About Bazario
about_page.subtitle: Since 2009, Bazario has stood beside Iranian families to bring them quality home appliances at fair prices with real warranties.
about_page.story_title: From a small dealership to a nationwide distributor
about_page.story_p1: Bazario started as a small dealership in Tehran with a simple goal: get genuine home appliances to customers directly, without unnecessary middlemen. Over the years, thanks to our customers' trust, that small dealership grew into a nationwide distribution network with dozens of active branches.
about_page.story_p2: Today, Bazario works directly with trusted manufacturers and importers to offer live inventory and transparent pricing, delivering orders to your door on a schedule you choose.
about_page.mission_desc: Bazario's mission is simple: easy, transparent, and reliable access to quality home appliances for every Iranian family, backed by an official warranty and real support.
about_page.value1_desc: Every product is sourced from official manufacturers and importers and comes with a valid warranty.
about_page.value2_desc: Price and stock for every product are shown live from our warehouse — no hidden pricing.
about_page.value3_desc: Orders are delivered to your address in the time window you choose, with no hidden fees.
about_page.value4_desc: Bazario's support team stays with you through delivery and beyond.
